evidence: C1 sits immediately to the right of U1 alongside R9/R10 with no intervening parts, within a few mm of the ADC power pin.
Each channel reads bottom-to-top as terminal -> divider (R1/R2) -> clamp (D1) -> filter (C2) -> ADC U1 -> I2C header J5 with no doubling back.
Each channel strip is vertically aligned over its own terminal and the U1-to-C2/C3/C4/C5 fan preserves left-to-right order, so straight pad-to-pad connections do not cross.
Power enters at the J5 header (+3V3/GND) and flows directly to U1 with C1 at the load; there is no regulation stage on this board so no bulk-cap ordering applies.
